CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2668 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 88c469c7eddca86e4f3d0d0dda98d1cde4541ad9. Bus nonce: 93bf616421c49bbc4b66fc046c0f0659. Never send push notifications. Write no Claude Code footer, no Co-Authored-By or Claude-Session trailer and no claude.ai session link in any commit, pull-request body or comment you produce; check your commits with `git log --format=%B` before pushing.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin 88c469c7eddca86e4f3d0d0dda98d1cde4541ad9`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge 88c469c7eddca86e4f3d0d0dda98d1cde4541ad9` or `Fix review: blocked 88c469c7eddca86e4f3d0d0dda98d1cde4541ad9 <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: 93bf616421c49bbc4b66fc046c0f0659`, then the body in sections. A blocked verdict's block goes under `## Block`. Each finding this PR does not settle (a defect, a surviving mutant, a deferral, a follow-up, a task owed after the merge) is its own bullet under `## Findings` ending in its own `Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>` (finding-propagation.md). Everything else (RESULT lines, re-runs, CI state, figures you could not re-derive) goes under `## Evidence`: tools/audit/carry_audit.py reads no item there as a finding unless it hands something on (deferred, for a later, follow-up, minor, advisory, residual, still has to, not blocking ...; a check that does not block is evidence only in the clause saying it is not a required check and does not block, never in the rest of its sentence: a nit or defect beside it is a finding), and the merge train parks a verdict holding a finding with no `Carry:`. Put the evidence files in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `88c469c7eddca86e4f3d0d0dda98d1cde4541ad9` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2668 88c469c7eddca86e4f3d0d0dda98d1cde4541ad9") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2668-93bf6164`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Fix reviewer for PR #2668, R10-FLY-NO-FOOTERS-PUSH-PATHS (lane FLY, size S, instrument), branch fix/r10-fly-no-footers-push-paths, head 88c469c7eddca86e4f3d0d0dda98d1cde4541ad9. The code head is 8aefaa95; 22bb373a merges origin/main 12032c43 and the head adds the delivery row. Follow dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md exactly, from a detached worktree at the head. Your ev/ MUST contain ev/HEAD.txt holding the full 40-hex head, or the relay refuses the verdict.

Claim: two holes let commit 767a06f7f (Co-Authored-By plus Claude-Session trailers) and its re-commit cc51e6626 reach a PR head after guard a4b27986. Fix: (1) handoff_push.sh, body_push.sh and `ci_probe.py push` judge every commit message they publish, via ref_privacy's shared attribution check, not a copy; (2) app_push.sh judges every commit in origin/main..HEAD, not only first-published ones. Author identity is out of scope by the orchestrator's ruling; the body records it. The body also carries the orchestrator's ruling on the allow-list proposal: no allow-list, merge order instead.

Verify adversarially, with the finder's harness:
(1) Three-dot diff: only the five group files (tools/audit/seat/handoff_push.sh, body_push.sh, ci_probe.py, ref_privacy.py, tools/pr/app_push.sh), plus tests/fixtures for them, tools/audit/seat/INSTRUMENTS.md and dev/programme/delivery/2668.md.
(2) Rebuild both holes on a throwaway origin (a local bare repo). (a) A commit carrying a Co-Authored-By trailer, pushed through handoff_push.sh, body_push.sh and ci_probe.py push: main lets it through, the head refuses it on each path. (b) A trailer commit first published on a ci-probe/* ref, then included in a branch app_push.sh pushes: main lets it through, the head refuses it.
(3) Null controls: a clean commit passes every path; a commit AUTHORED `Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>` with no trailer passes (author identity is out of scope); a branch with no commits over main passes.
(4) Mutants: drop the judgement on each of the three push paths in turn; restrict app_push back to first-published commits; make the shared check always pass. Each must go red. Confirm the check is shared rather than copied: one definition, called from every path.
(5) The impact table: re-measure which open PRs carry a trailer commit in origin/main..head at the time you run. #2632 is already merged; #2620 should still list its three pre-cutoff SHAs. State whether the ruling (merge order, no allow-list) leaves any open PR that must push again through app_push and would be refused. Name it as a Finding with a Carry if so.
(6) Every figure in the body. `git merge-tree --write-tree` against origin/main is clean. Read CI with one bulk check-runs call. No commit carries a footer. Record the scoped-gate MODE line.
Rules: PREPR_SKIP_CLOSURES=1; spare the GitHub API; no Claude footers.
